text: cool. that in part landed, i was hoping though to be able to paint on textures, upload images from here etc.
resolution: The iso PAINT panel could browse the texture library but had no way to bring NEW textures in. Added a TEXTURE row with two doors. 'open image…' runs the native file picker, reads the image's pixel size, wraps it as a full-bleed decal material through the SAME saveDecalTexture door /compose uses, and sets it as the BRUSH — deliberately NOT auto-painting every side, because an uploaded image is usually for one face (a poster/sign), so the natural next click is a face button (N/E/S/W/Top/In) that paints just that side; the upload also lands in the browser live so its swatch can cover all sides if wanted. 'paint a texture…' opens the full /workbench painter (draw/layer/smart-select/save-to-library), whose saved output shows up in the browser to apply. The material browser now subscribes to the custom-texture store (useCustomTextures) so uploads/painted textures appear instantly with no reload. This also answers the follow-up 'how do I control if it's only on one face' — upload sets the brush, then a single face button places it on exactly that side. The pure doc-builder (faceTextureDoc.ts) is split from the host-coupled upload and tested headless against the decal validator (4/4 green, no IFTTT/timer chain pulled). Note: the pre-existing untracked materials.test.ts pulls a setInterval-at-load IFTTT chain that bare v8cli lacks — that is another lane's file, not touched here.
